plans.goalSummary: Power, first-step speed and conditioning for tennis
plans.name: Court-ready strength
plans.rationale: Heavy lifting sits on Monday, two days from your match, and speed work on Friday stays short so you're fresh for Saturday.

profile.goalText: Improve overall performance on the court: first-step speed, power and staying fresh in the third set.
profile.limitations: Right shoulder gets cranky with heavy overhead pressing.
